result.reply: What's actually messy — duplicates, stale tickets with no owner, wrong priority tags, or just needs re-ordering? Before I touch anything: my plan would be to close/merge obvious dupes, flag anything stale (no activity, no owner) for a decision, and re-check tags on the rest — but that changes real state on a bunch of tickets, so tell me if that's the right scope or if you had something narrower in mind.
